fiche: Un gland paresseux qui s'est réveillé un jour avec des jambes et passe ses siestes au pied des chênes de la forêt.
apparence: Acorn-shaped creature with a wooden shell body and a textured cap; colors: warm brown, moss green, amber.

stades.bebe: A round acorn with huge sleepy eyes, a tiny cap and no limbs, rolling on the ground.
stades.enfant: Two stubby twig legs and small leaf hands sprout from the acorn body.
stades.ado: The body stretches into an oval, the cap grows a curly stem antenna and the arms become thin branches.
stades.adulte: A sturdy acorn knight with a thick spiky cap like a helmet, bark-plated arms and a hazelnut shield.
stades.ancien: An elder acorn with a cracked shell, a long moss beard, a tiny sapling growing from its cap and a twig cane.

fiche: Un petit champignon guerrier qui défend les cercles de fées des sous-bois humides avec un courage démesuré.
apparence: Mushroom warrior with a spotted cap, pale fleshy stem body and gills; colors: red, cream white, moss green.

stades.bebe: A tiny round button mushroom with big eyes and a red spotted cap, no arms.
stades.enfant: Little stubby arms appear and it carries a pine needle like a sword.
stades.ado: The stem lengthens into a lean body, the cap widens into a wide-brimmed hat and a gill skirt forms.
stades.adulte: A muscular mushroom fighter with a hard armored cap, a bark breastplate and a sharpened thorn spear.
stades.ancien: A veteran mushroom with a sagging wrinkled cap, glowing spores drifting around it, a lichen beard and a mossy staff.

fiche: Une créature-fleur qui volette de prairie en prairie en battant de ses pétales comme des ailes.
apparence: Flower creature with petal wings, a pollen-yellow fuzzy core and stem tail; colors: pink, sunny yellow, leaf green.

stades.bebe: A closed round flower bud with big eyes and two tiny leaf flaps.
stades.enfant: The bud half-opens into four petal wings and a short curly stem tail appears.
stades.ado: The petals become long butterfly-like wings, two stamen antennae sprout and the body turns slender.
stades.adulte: A graceful flying blossom with six layered glowing petal wings, a pollen mane and a long trailing vine tail.
stades.ancien: An elder bloom with faded silvery petals, seed puffs floating like a halo and drooping wise stamen whiskers.

fiche: Une boule de mousse vivante qui s'étale sur les pierres humides des sous-bois et absorbe la rosée.
apparence: Soft blob made of thick fluffy moss with tiny sprouts and dewdrops; colors: moss green, dark green, dew blue.

stades.bebe: A small round moss puff with two shiny eyes and a single dewdrop on top.
stades.enfant: The blob flattens a little and grows tiny fern fronds like ears and a few clover sprouts.
stades.ado: It becomes a wide wobbly moss mound with pseudopod lumps and small pebbles stuck inside.
stades.adulte: A large shaggy moss mass with long dangling moss tendrils, embedded stones and glowing dewdrop eyes.
stades.ancien: An ancient moss hill with tiny flowers and a miniature tree growing on its back and lichen patterns like wrinkles.

fiche: Un renardeau fait de ronces entrelacées qui chaparde les baies dans les haies des lisières.
apparence: Fox-like quadruped woven from bramble vines with thorns and berries; colors: dark green, bramble brown, berry purple.

stades.bebe: A round ball of soft vines with big eyes, two leaf ears and a single blackberry nose.
stades.enfant: Four little vine legs and a bushy leafy tail appear.
stades.ado: The body lengthens like a fox, thorns grow along the back and berry clusters hang from the tail.
stades.adulte: A sleek bramble fox with a mane of sharp thorns, claw-like thorn paws and a whip-like thorny tail.
stades.ancien: An old bramble fox with dried silver-grey vines, a white flower crown and berries like glowing beads.

fiche: Un esprit des racines qui flotte sous la terre et remonte la nuit pour veiller sur les jeunes pousses.
apparence: Floating root spirit with a bulb head, trailing root tendrils and soft inner glow; colors: pale beige, amber, glowing green.

stades.bebe: A small round bulb like a radish with big glowing eyes and a single sprout on its head.
stades.enfant: Thin root tendrils dangle beneath it and two leaf arms appear.
stades.ado: The bulb becomes a teardrop shape, the roots grow long and braided and a glowing core lights up inside.
stades.adulte: A tall floating root spirit with a hood of leaves, many writhing luminous roots and amber lantern eyes.
stades.ancien: An elder spirit with gnarled knotted roots like a long beard, a halo of floating soil motes and cracked glowing bark.

fiche: Une plante carnivore affamée qui rampe sur ses racines dans les marais et happe tout ce qui bourdonne.
apparence: Carnivorous plant with a trap-jaw head lined with soft teeth, leafy body and root feet; colors: lime green, crimson, yellow.

stades.bebe: A round closed pod with big eyes and a tiny smiling seam, sitting on a root nub.
stades.enfant: The pod opens into a small trap mouth with soft spikes and two leaf arms sprout.
stades.ado: The stem lengthens into a neck, root legs spread for crawling and red dotted lures grow on the jaws.
stades.adulte: A big crawling flytrap with a huge crimson jaw full of thorn teeth, several snapping side pods and thick root tentacles.
stades.ancien: An ancient trap plant with a woody cracked jaw, drooping vine whiskers, glowing nectar drops and a crown of pale flowers.

fiche: Un champignon lumineux qui flotte dans les grottes et les forêts nocturnes pour guider les voyageurs égarés.
apparence: Floating bioluminescent mushroom with a lantern-like cap and dangling glowing filaments; colors: teal glow, deep blue, amber.

stades.bebe: A tiny round glowing mushroom cap with big eyes, floating like a bubble.
stades.enfant: A short stem appears below the cap with two tiny dangling glowing threads.
stades.ado: The cap widens into a bell shape, more glowing filaments hang like a jellyfish and small leaf fins appear.
stades.adulte: A large floating lantern mushroom with a luminous ribbed cap, a cage of bark around a light core and long trailing glow filaments.
stades.ancien: An elder lantern with a cracked glowing cap, a curtain of hanging moss, tiny baby mushrooms orbiting it and a soft halo.

fiche: Un serpent de lianes qui s'enroule autour des grands arbres de la jungle et se confond avec la végétation.
apparence: Snake made of twisted jungle vines with leaf scales and orchid flowers; colors: jungle green, bark brown, orchid magenta.

stades.bebe: A short round vine coil with a cute bud head and big eyes.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens into a small snake and leaf scales start to cover it.
stades.ado: The vines braid into a thicker body, tendril whiskers sprout and orchid buds grow along the spine.
stades.adulte: A huge coiling vine serpent with a hooded head of broad leaves, blooming orchids and thorny constricting coils.
stades.ancien: An ancient vine serpent with a woody hardened body, hanging aerial roots like a beard and a crown of glowing orchids.

fiche: Un cerf à la peau d'écorce dont les bois sont de vraies branches feuillues qui changent avec les saisons.
apparence: Deer-like quadruped with bark skin, branch antlers and leafy tufts; colors: bark brown, leaf green, autumn amber.

stades.bebe: A round fawn-shaped seedling with big eyes, tiny legs and two little sprouts on its head.
stades.enfant: Its legs lengthen like twigs and the sprouts grow into small forked branches.
stades.ado: The body becomes slender and bark-plated, the antlers grow wide and leaves sprout on them.
stades.adulte: A majestic bark stag with huge branching antlers full of amber leaves, a mossy chest mane and hooves like roots.
stades.ancien: An elder stag with enormous bare antlers hung with lichen and birds' nests, a deep-cracked bark hide and a moss beard.

fiche: Un batracien végétal qui se cache sous un nénuphar géant dans les marais et engloutit tout ce qui s'y pose.
apparence: Frog-like swamp plant creature with a giant lily pad back and a wide lotus mouth; colors: swamp green, lotus pink, murky teal.

stades.bebe: A round green seed pod with big eyes floating on a tiny lily pad.
stades.enfant: Four little webbed leaf legs appear and the lily pad grows on its back like a shell.
stades.ado: The body flattens like a toad, the mouth widens into a lotus-petal maw and reed spines grow on its sides.
stades.adulte: A huge crouching swamp beast with a massive lily pad carapace, a blooming lotus on its head and a gaping petal-lined jaw.
stades.ancien: An ancient swamp lord with a cracked lily pad covered in smaller pads and flowers, dangling algae whiskers and glowing lotus eyes.

fiche: Une créature de sève et d'ambre aux ailes de feuilles translucides qui ne sort que les nuits de pleine lune.
apparence: Moth-like flyer made of hardened amber resin with translucent leaf wings and a seed core; colors: amber, pale gold, night blue.

stades.bebe: A round drop of amber resin with big eyes and a tiny seed visible inside.
stades.enfant: Two small translucent leaf wings and feathery leaf antennae appear.
stades.ado: The body becomes an elongated amber segment and the wings grow large with glowing vein patterns.
stades.adulte: A large amber moth with four huge veined leaf wings glowing under moonlight, crystal resin claws and feathery antennae.
stades.ancien: An elder amber moth with ancient insects and leaves trapped in its resin body, a crescent moon halo and frayed golden wings.

fiche: Un mille-pattes de mycélium qui tisse des réseaux souterrains entre les racines de toute une forêt.
apparence: Many-legged creature made of white fungal threads with mushroom-cap segments; colors: ivory white, mushroom brown, glowing violet.

stades.bebe: A small round fuzzy ball of white threads with big eyes and two tiny mushroom caps on top.
stades.enfant: The body splits into three segments with short thread legs underneath.
stades.ado: It grows many segments, each topped with a small mushroom cap, and thread antennae appear.
stades.adulte: A long multi-legged fungal crawler with dozens of fiber legs, a shelf-fungus armor on each segment and glowing violet spore vents.
stades.ancien: An elder mycelium centipede trailing a web of threads, with huge old bracket fungi plating and a halo of drifting glowing spores.

fiche: Un arbre animé mi-chêne mi-rocher qui garde les cols des montagnes boisées depuis des siècles.
apparence: Walking tree giant with oak bark body fused with boulders, root feet and a leafy crown; colors: oak brown, stone grey, moss green.

stades.bebe: A round stone with a tiny oak sapling on top, big eyes and no limbs.
stades.enfant: Two short root legs and twig arms grow from the stone.
stades.ado: The sapling thickens into a trunk body, the stone becomes a chest plate and a leafy crown appears.
stades.adulte: A massive oak giant with boulder fists, rock-plated shoulders, thick root legs and a wide crown of leaves.
stades.ancien: A colossal elder oak with deep-cracked bark, a long hanging moss beard, birds nesting in its crown and runes glowing in the stones.

fiche: Le seigneur de toutes les forêts, un arbre-roi millénaire dont chaque pas fait germer une prairie fleurie.
apparence: Regal tree lord with a white bark body, golden sap veins, a crown of branches and glowing flowers; colors: silver-white bark, gold amber, luminous green.

stades.bebe: A round glowing seed with big eyes and a single golden leaf on its head.
stades.enfant: Two root legs and slim twig arms sprout, with a tiny circlet of buds on its head.
stades.ado: The body grows into a slender white-bark sapling with golden veins and a cape of hanging leaves.
stades.adulte: A towering tree king with a branching crown full of glowing flowers, golden sap armor, a bark cape and a living staff of vines.
stades.ancien: An immortal elder tree lord with a vast canopy crown, flowing moss beard, ancient relic stones in its bark and a radiant halo of pollen light.
